description:
Experience Without Limits
Come shape the future of brand experience.

At Jack Morton, we design and build head-turning, smile-inducing, impact-driving brand experiences that redefine what experiential marketing can achieve. We help our clients unlock the full value of experiences by turning bold ideas into meaningful connections.

That takes a team that's bold, curious, and acts as one. We build on each other's ideas, challenge conventions, and show up for one another every day. Here, you'll do your best work, grow quickly, and partner across clients, disciplines, and global teams to bring new ideas to life.

This is a place where curiosity drives what’s next, boldness raises the bar, and every win is shared. Where ownership is expected, egos are left at the door, and the work reflects the passion and talent of the people behind it.

Experience without limits—in your work, your growth, and your impact.

Lead Developer / Technical Lead - Freelance

AI-Enabled Product & Data Platform 

Hands-on engineering lead to turn a mature R&D prototype into a secure, reusable, production-ready product platform. 

Role Details 

Reports to 

Product Lead / Technology Executive 

Engagement 

Contract, fixed-term or permanent - to be confirmed 

Working pattern 

Flexible hybrid / remote 

Start date 

As soon as possible 

Role Overview 

We are seeking a senior, hands-on technical lead to assume ownership of an existing product codebase and lead its transition from R&D prototype to production-ready platform. The role will contribute code from day one, own application architecture and delivery standards, and coordinate a second developer focused on the shared data and intelligence layer. The successful candidate will work across product, data, cloud, QA, security and UX to deliver a secure, scalable first release and establish the foundation for future modules. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Assess the current codebase, environments and contracts, then lead the transition from prototype to a secure, maintainable product. 
  • Design and build the reusable platform core, including the API/BFF layer, operational database, tenant/client/event model, roles, permissions, entitlements, configuration, audit and usage telemetry. 
  • Remain hands-on across React/TypeScript front-end development, Python/FastAPI services, AWS infrastructure, integrations and automated testing. 
  • Define versioned APIs and data contracts between the product platform and the shared data/intelligence layer, including backward-compatibility rules. 
  • Provide day-to-day technical oversight to the data-platform developer and coordinate data products, AI tools, evidence/lineage outputs, schema changes and release dependencies. 
  • Enforce client and event-level isolation, anonymized data handling, secure access, auditability and governed AI outputs. 
  • Establish engineering standards for code review, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, quality gates, security and release management. 
  • Maintain concise architecture documentation using UML/PlantUML and Architecture Decision Records, while mentoring and unblocking additional developers as the team grows. 
  • Use generative AI to accelerate implementation, testing, documentation and refactoring while maintaining human review and secure engineering controls. 

Technical Environment 

Front end 

React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, data visualization and schema validation. 

Back end 

Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and container/serverless API patterns. 

Cloud 

AWS API Gateway, Lambda, Cognito/OIDC, S3, CloudFront, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. 

Data & AI 

PostgreSQL-compatible operational database; Snowflake or comparable cloud data platform; governed enterprise AI/LLM integration. 

DevOps 

Terraform, GitHub Actions, Docker, OIDC-based deployment and multi-account governance. 

Quality 

Unit, integration, contract, security, data-quality and end-to-end testing. 

Required Experience 

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a lead developer, technical lead or hands-on architecture role. 
  • Strong full-stack capability across modern React/TypeScript applications and Python/FastAPI services. 
  • Production experience with AWS, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, secrets management and secure identity patterns. 
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform. 
  • Strong understanding of multi-tenant SaaS, RBAC, entitlements, client isolation, auditability and security-by-design. 
  • Experience designing versioned APIs, schemas and data contracts, including breaking-change management. 
  • Strong automated testing discipline across application, data and AI workflows. 
  • Proven ability to lead and mentor developers while remaining an active contributor to the codebase. 
  • Clear communication with product, data, QA, security and executive stakeholders. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Snowflake Cortex, enterprise AI agents, governed AI tools, RAG or comparable LLM platforms. 
  • Cognito, OAuth/OIDC, serverless/event-driven integration patterns and AWS multi-account governance. 
  • Data anonymization, pseudonymization, DLP, consent, retention and privacy-sensitive product design. 
  • TOGAF, UML/PlantUML and ADR-driven architecture governance. 
  • Usage metering, cloud cost attribution, FinOps or consumption-based product models. 
  • Client-facing consulting, analytics products, event/attendee data or product-incubation experience. 

First 90 Days 

Days 1-30 

Assume ownership of the repository and environments; run the platform locally; assess architecture, contracts, security and deployment; produce a current-state/target-state gap assessment and prioritized backlog. 

Days 31-60 

Begin productizing the platform core: operational database, client/event entitlements, versioned API/BFF, data-platform adapter, local development workflow and QA/security test harness. 

Days 61-90 

Deliver a pilot-ready end-to-end thin slice with secure client isolation, product-grade dashboards, governed AI outputs, audit/usage telemetry, repeatable deployment and a roadmap for team growth. 

Working Model 

This is a hands-on lead role, not a management-only position. The successful candidate will initially spend a significant portion of the engagement writing and reviewing production code while setting technical standards and overseeing the data-platform developer. The role will expand as additional engineers and product modules are funded.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you'll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ or Brussels office for a minimum of 3 days a week. 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk.
  • Advise on the competition and antitrust dimensions of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and commercial partnerships, partnering closely with Corporate Development and our sales teams.
  • Manage antitrust and competition regulatory investigations and inquiries globally.
  • Help build out DoorDash's international competition compliance program, partnering with the Director, Competition & Litigation on training, policies, and processes across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.
  • Support competition-related litigation matters as needed, including document collection and review, witness preparation, and responses to third-party subpoenas.
  • Partner with policy and government relations teams to track legal and regulatory developments that could affect the business.

We're excited about you because…

  • You are a qualified solicitor in England & Wales (or bring similar qualifications in another European jurisdiction) with significant experience providing strategic legal advice to international businesses.

raw.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

About Kraken Utilities

Kraken is a globally proven technology platform, already licensed to support over 55 million customer accounts, with a target of 100 million by 2027. It is one of the most advanced, AI-driven platforms for utility management—covering billing, CRM, meter data, and intelligent customer communications.

We are now extending Kraken beyond energy into water and broadband, forming a new division: Kraken Utilities.

Over the past three years, this team has been built from the ground up to re-architect and evolve Kraken for new industries—solving complex challenges like water leak detection, customer experience transformation, and high-volume data processing.

We are in a rapid growth phase, with clients including:
Severn Trent, Leep, Portsmouth Water, Essential Energy, TalkTalk, and Cuckoo, and a global team of 120+ people.

🏡 Where you'll fit in

  • This is not a “business-as-usual” engineering role.

    You will play a key role in shaping how Kraken integrates with telecom and utility ecosystems—designing systems that are scalable, resilient, and developer-friendly.

    You’ll act as a systems thinker and architect, solving multi-team challenges and building platforms that other engineers (internal and external) rely on.

🚀 What you’ll own

  • Design and develop new components of the Kraken platform for broadband utilities

  • You will work closely with (and help shape) the OSS & Integrations function, which is responsible for:

  • Partner Integrations

    • Build and maintain integrations with telecom network providers, CPE (router) providers, and call record systems

    • Handle a mix of REST and SOAP APIs to provision and query network state

  • API & Platform Development

    • Develop robust APIs connecting Kraken to external telco infrastructure

    • Improve integration reliability and scalability

  • Automation

    • Create workflows to streamline operations between Kraken and partner systems


Drive Architectural Improvements

  • Reduce tight coupling between integrations and core business logic (e.g. Order Management, Quoting, Charging)

  • Improve system stability and developer productivity

  • Lead on microservice design, contract testing, and integration patterns

  • Build facades and emulators to simulate integrations

  • Treat internal developers as first-class customers

  • Design and build an SDK layer for third party developers

Team & Culture Impact

  • Help scale Kraken Utilities by embedding a strong engineering and customer-first culture

  • Influence how teams are structured and how systems evolve

  • Take ownership of architectural direction and execution

🧠 What you bring to the party

  • We’re looking for an empathetic leader who enjoys solving complex system problems.

    • You’ll be responsible for leading a team of engineers, making decisions on how the team operates and setting the technical direction of the team.

    • You'll be curious about AI developer workflows, ready to experiment and introduce new ways of working

    • This role will involve line management duties, as well as being hands on and close to the code.

    • You’ll be responsible for ensuring the quality of the code being delivered through thoughtful code review.

    • Work with other engineering teams and external engineering teams regularly

    • Work with client delivery to help prioritize, deliver and maintain work required by clients.

    • Be responsible for monitoring and alerting of production systems and where required, lead and manage incidents.

    Core Technical Skills

    • Experience with Python stack and Web frameworks

    • Strong domain modelling skills

    • HTTP & REST APIs

    • Building robust, fault-tolerant systems

    ⭐️ Bonus points

    • Experience building SDKs or APIs for other developers

What Makes This Role Different

  • You’ll work on platform-level architecture, not just features

  • You’ll design systems that impact multiple teams and external partners

  • You’ll help redefine how developers interact with Kraken via SDKs and abstractions

You’ll have real ownership in shaping both technology and team structure

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What is TechOps?

TechOps at Kraken is a modern, lean evolution of traditional enterprise IT. We span everything from hands-on frontline support through to high-impact technical projects and long-term strategic improvements.

We are building a small, highly effective TechOps team and are looking for an ambitious, experienced TechOps Generalist to help us scale Kraken safely, securely, and with a strong focus on people.

This is a broad role with a huge amount of variety. You’ll work across identity, devices, SaaS, networking, automation, and office infrastructure - often at the same time. Ambiguity is a constant, and we’re looking for someone who enjoys making sense of it and turning it into action.

We operate almost entirely in the cloud, so you’ll be exposed to a wide range of modern tools and technologies across the business.

🏡 Where you'll fit in

  • As a TechOps Generalist, you’ll be a core contributor to the day-to-day delivery of TechOps services, working closely with the TechOps Lead and the wider global TechOps team.

    This is a role with real ownership. You’ll be trusted to take responsibility for problems and projects end-to-end, contribute to technical decision-making, and help shape how TechOps operates as we grow.

    We strongly believe that great TechOps starts with empathy. You’ll spend a significant portion of your time supporting Kraken employees directly, seeing first-hand the problems they face and helping ensure technology enables rather than blocks great work.

    We prioritise friendly, human support over SLAs or ticket numbers. Our aim is to deliver such a good experience that technology fades into the background, and when support is needed, it’s easy, human, and effective.

🚀 What you’ll own

  • Provide hands-on 1st, 2nd, and 3rd line support across the business

  • Own and deliver TechOps work across identity, devices, SaaS, networking, and office infrastructure

  • Work closely with the TechOps Lead to balance reactive support with proactive, planned improvements

  • Contribute to technical projects that improve security, reliability, and scalability

  • Design, improve, and automate systems and processes to reduce manual effort and operational risk

  • Collaborate closely with Security, Engineering, and other teams to balance security, productivity, and user experience

  • Support our offices across the globe

  • Identify recurring problems and help build long-term solutions rather than short-term workarounds

Example TechOps projects include:

  • macOS and Windows MDM improvements and migrations

  • Identity provider and SSO improvements

  • Device trust and posture compliance solutions

  • Replacing insecure authentication factors with phishing-resistant alternatives

  • Office networking, AV, and access control improvements

  • SaaS migrations and integrations

🧠 What you bring to the party

Must have

  • Strong hands-on experience in an IT, TechOps, or systems-focused role

  • Deep knowledge of Windows and macOS, with confident troubleshooting skills

  • Hands-on experience providing 1st, 2nd, and 3rd line support

  • Comfort operating in highly ambiguous environments and managing competing priorities

  • A strong technical foundation across identity, MDM, SaaS, and networking

  • Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • A people-first mindset and a conscientious approach to decision-making

Should have

  • Experience supporting macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android environments

  • Experience with Identity & Access Management platforms (e.g. Okta, Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra)

  • Understanding of SSO technologies such as OAuth, SAML, and SCIM

  • Enjoyment of scripting, APIs, and automating repetitive or error-prone tasks

  • Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams

⭐️ Bonus points

  • A foundational understanding of programming or software engineering

  • Familiarity with security tooling such as CrowdStrike, Kolide, osquery, or Zscaler

  • Experience with office networking (we use Cisco Meraki)

  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS

Don't think you check off all of the above? We love hiring passionate people with a drive to learn so get in touch and let us know which areas you don't currently have confidence and/or experience with, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Field Marketing Manager, EMEA
description: About Ema Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs. We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale. Role Overview We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager, based in London, to build and run Ema’s on-the-ground presence across the UK and Europe. You’ll cover industry events, tradeshows, executive dinners and sponsored programs in our priority markets: the UK, France, DACH and Benelux, with the Nordics and wider Europe as they grow. You’ll be the connective tissue between our BDR, Sales, AI Strategy, Product Marketing and Design teams, turning live experiences into qualified pipeline. You’ll be Ema’s first field marketer in the region, working alongside our US Field Marketing Manager. Our Marketing Lead sets the global event strategy and budget. Within that, you own the UK and Europe calendar: which events we back, which cities we show up in, and how we run them. Then you execute it. We need someone who thrives in startup environments, moves fast, and doesn’t wait for permission to solve problems. If you’ve built field programs across more than one European market, know how to get scrappy when budgets are tight, and can run a booth in London one week and an executive dinner in Paris the next, we want to talk to you. Key Responsibilities Regional Event Planning Build and maintain the UK and Europe event calendar within the global strategy and budget set by our Marketing Lead. Recommend which conferences, tradeshows and sponsorships to back in each market, based on target accounts, pipeline and cost. Know the difference between an event that matters in London and one that matters in Munich or Amsterdam. Work with the US Field Marketing Manager to share what works, reuse playbooks and assets, and keep the two programs consistent. Event Execution & Operations Plan, manage and execute end-to-end logistics for industry conferences, tradeshows and Ema-hosted events (executive roundtables, dinners, meetups) across the UK and Europe. Manage all on-site operations: booth design, staffing, signage, swag, shipping, A/V, catering and speaker logistics. You’re the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. Handle the cross-border details that US events don’t have: shipping and customs between the UK and the EU, local venues and suppliers, and GDPR-compliant lead capture. Evaluate sponsorship opportunities, negotiate vendor contracts and manage event budgets to maximise ROI. Pipeline & Sales Alignment Work with the BDR team and Sales to align event programming with target accounts and pipeline goals in each market. We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager, based in London, to build and run Ema’s on-the-ground presence across the UK and Europe. You’ll cover industry events, tradeshows, executive dinners and sponsored programs in our priority markets: the UK, France, DACH and Benelux, with the Nordics and wider Europe as they grow. Within that, you own the UK and Europe calendar: which events we back, which cities we show up in, and how we run them. Then you execute it.

We need someone who thrives in startup environments, moves fast, and doesn’t wait for permission to solve problems. If you’ve built field programs across more than one European market, know how to get scrappy when budgets are tight, and can run a booth in London one week and an executive dinner in Paris the next, we want to talk to you.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Event Planning

  • Build and maintain the UK and Europe event calendar within the global strategy and budget set by our Marketing Lead.

  • Recommend which conferences, tradeshows and sponsorships to back in each market, based on target accounts, pipeline and cost. Know the difference between an event that matters in London and one that matters in Munich or Amsterdam.

  • Work with the US Field Marketing Manager to share what works, reuse playbooks and assets, and keep the two programs consistent.

Event Execution & Operations

  • Plan, manage and execute end-to-end logistics for industry conferences, tradeshows and Ema-hosted events (executive roundtables, dinners, meetups) across the UK and Europe.

  • Manage all on-site operations: booth design, staffing, signage, swag, shipping, A/V, catering and speaker logistics. You’re the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Handle the cross-border details that US events don’t have: shipping and customs between the UK and the EU, local venues and suppliers, and GDPR-compliant lead capture.

  • Evaluate sponsorship opportunities, negotiate vendor contracts and manage event budgets to maximise ROI.

Pipeline & Sales Alignment

  • Work with the BDR team and Sales to align event programming with target accounts and pipeline goals in each market.

  • Coordinate pre-event outreach, booth and event activations, and post-event follow-up to drive lead conversion.

  • Coordinate with AI Strategists, Product Marketing and Design so demos, collateral and messaging are event-ready, on-brand and right for the local audience.

  • Track and report on event performance by market (leads generated, pipeline influenced, cost per lead, attendance, deal acceleration) and share insights to improve the program.

description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Synchronised Model Deposit Operations Team is a specialized unit within the Operations Department responsible for the technical and operational management of real-time deposit flows for partners using Portal, Hybrid, and Automation integration models. In these models, the Deposit-taking Bank (DtB) remains the source of truth for the deposit ledger, and the team ensures Raisin’s systems stay aligned with the bank's records.


Your Responsibilities

  • Payment & Sync Governance: Execute and supervise real-time automated payment flows. Perform manual interventions and corrective postings under the Four-Eyes Principle to resolve synchronization lags and ensure transaction finality.
  • Data Integrity & Reconciliation: Conduct daily high-frequency reconciliations between internal ledgers and partner bank data. Investigate "out-of-sync" scenarios to ensure permanent data parity and maintain audit-proof documentation.
  • Partner & SLA Management: Serve as the primary operational liaison for Sync Model DtBs. Monitor interface uptime and latency in accordance with regulation, leading root cause analyses for any technical drifts.
  • Technical Integration: Coordinate tech enhancements and system releases. Lead Operational Validation to ensure that technical rollouts maintain system stability and data integrity.
  • Process Optimization: Partner with Product and Tech to refine processes and deposit logic. Provide operational requirements for new features, driving automation and scaling the onboarding of new partners while mitigating Operational Risk (OpRisk).

Your Profile

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Business Administration, Data Science, Economics, Law, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Prior internship or practical experience in startups, consulting, or operations is a plus. Early-career candidates and motivated fast-learners are also strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel for data organization and analysis.
  • Comfortable balancing independent problem-solving with close team collaboration.
  • Advanced proficiency (C1 level or higher) in both English and German. 

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

  • Employee Development Budget of €400 and one full training day per year.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role 

Nebius Token Factory needs scientists who can turn frontier inference bottlenecks into research problems, publish credible work, and then help ship the results into production. This is not a papers-only research role. The Applied Scientist is expected to design rigorous experiments, write strong code, collaborate with engineers, and convert research into deployed inference capabilities.

A Senior Applied Scientist owns well-scoped research and production optimization projects. They can publish or prepare high-quality technical work while also producing code, experiments, and prototypes that engineers can use.

Your responsibilities: 

  • Own focused research projects from hypothesis through experiment, ablation, prototype, and production handoff.

  • Prepare internal reports, technical blogs, or papers when the work is externally credible.

  • Partner directly with MLEs to ensure research prototypes become usable production components.

  • Define and execute research programs in efficient LLM and VLM inference with measurable production impact.

  • Invent, evaluate, and productionize methods for quantization, QAT, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.

  • Build high-quality prototypes in PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, then work with MLEs and platform engineers to productionize them.

  • Design rigorous evaluation methodology covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token.

  • Publish papers, technical reports, blog posts, and open-source artifacts that build external credibility for Nebius Token Factory.

  • Collaborate with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to choose high-leverage research bets.

  • Mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system tradeoffs.

Must-haves: 

  • PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied math, or a closely related field.

  • Strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.

  • Strong hands-on coding ability in Python and PyTorch; ability to move from idea to experiment to prototype quickly.

  • Deep understanding of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving tradeoffs.

  • Strong experimental design skills, including ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-haves: 

  • First-author publications in NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, HPCA, or comparable venues.

  • Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.

  • Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.

  • Experience with post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation when connected to inference quality or efficiency.

  • Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, high-quality technical blogs, or invited talks in efficient AI systems.

 

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Location: Berlin offices / hybrid

Term: Full-time, permanent

Salary: Depending on experience

Start date: as soon as possible

  • Are you passionate about engineering and its application to acoustics and audio reproduction?
  • Are you an Embedded Software Engineer looking to join an innovative team for creating audio products?

If the answer to these questions is yes, then we’d love to hear from you!

At ADAM Audio, our profound passion for audio and acoustics drives our pursuit for excellence. We are pushing the boundaries of innovation in the field of audio and acoustics. Our commitment to excellence and cutting-edge engineering drives our mission to deliver ground-breaking solutions to our customers. The successful candidate with have previous experience in audio electronics.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • You will be collaborating closely with cross-functional and multi-cultural teams across the company and external partners, to define, prototype and develop products from early sketches on to market introduction and maintenance.
  • On a day-to-day basis you’ll be responsible for providing the firmware code for our hardware products, including evaluation of new technologies, debugging prototype hardware and ensuring your code is suitable for mass production and complies with latest market regulations (CE, FCC, CRA etc.). You'll have the opportunity to shape the direction of our embedded projects and you’ll be involved in the project's lifecycles. You’ll be refining product specifications, producing innovative designs and solutions and engaging with a multi-discipline team. You’ll be planning your activities, estimating your work and collaborating to meet deadlines and product requirements as well as working hands-on at functional prototypes and evaluation boards to debug and test electronic hardware designs with your code on it.
  • Individual and team development is important, and we’ll support you as you look for ways to grow and improve your personal knowledge and skills. We’ll also be looking for you to own and help improve our approach to embedded software engineering, including best practices, processes, and tools. There will also be opportunities to share knowledge and practices with all companies across the Focusrite group.

Skills and Experience Required:

  • Expert experience with micro-controllers and audio DSP (Digital Signal Processing) in general
  • Mastery in low-level programming at ARM-based-microcontrollers (STM32, NXP, etc.) and RTOS
  • Experience in C and modern C++ programming and common frameworks like Zephyr
  • Experience in working at systems with hard real-time constraints
  • Mastering a range of test equipment: oscilloscopes, logic analysers, bus analysers and audio analysers (Audio Precision)
  • Experience with meeting compliance regulations and standards (CE, FCC, EMC, RED, LVD etc.) for USB-, wireless- and Ethernet-connectivity, and battery powered devices
  • Experience with common Bluetooth and RF SoCs like Qualcomm, Airoha, Bestec etc.
  • Experience with networking protocols and chips/modules for Ethernet, WiFi and BLE
  • Strong ability to analyse and present trade-offs between cost, quality, and development time
  • Hands-on problem-solving and debugging skills, including lab work (test equipment, soldering etc.)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multi-disciplinary teams
  • Good English language skills (spoken and written) and ideally good German language skills.

Beneficial:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Electronics Engineering (or other relevant technical disciplines)
  • Familiarity with electronics and/or audio engineering.

Well, our colleagues are fantastic, of course! Here are some more good reasons to join our team:

  • Flexible working hours for a better work-life balance
  • A healthy mix of remote and office work
  • A harmonious and appreciative working atmosphere
  • Work on exciting projects in a unique industry as part of an international brand group
  • Employee discounts, including on Focusrite, Novation and Sequential products
  • Opportunities for professional development
  • ADAM Audio bonus programme – our employees share in the company's joint success!
  • Company pension scheme, ADAM Audio health programme, mental health first aiders, FeelGood Manager, Business Bike programme, regular staff events and much more.

You don’t have all the experience we’ve asked for?

Our priority is to find the right fit for the team and for the company, and we will always do what we can to support your individual development. raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
raw.description:
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
description: Aufgaben Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus! Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps. Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic -basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter. Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich. Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents – zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures. Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign . Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment -Prozesse mit. Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen. Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: PHP und Laravel Statamic PostgreSQL Livewire HTML, CSS und JavaScript RESTful APIs Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment -Prozessen Large Language Models und Coding Agents Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt. Qualifikation Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich in Laravel , Statamic , PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und Coding Agents sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen. Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern, Deployment und grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten. Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen. Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten. Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich. Was uns wichtig ist Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst. title: Senior Odoo Engineer ERP & E-Commerce (all genders)
description: Introduction Do you want to do more than just maintain an ERP system—do you want to help shape its future? As a Senior Odoo Engineer for ERP & E-Commerce (all genders), you’ll take responsibility for our Odoo platform—the system that powers sales, order processing, logistics, and accounting. You’ll further develop our in-house modules, continue the migration to the Odoo standard, integrate new countries, standardize payment processes, and build our new online store—ensuring it’s fully upgradeable, with streamlined workflows and genuine creative freedom. Your mission The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. raw.description:
Introduction

Do you want to do more than just maintain an ERP system—do you want to help shape its future? As a Senior Odoo Engineer for ERP & E-Commerce (all genders), you’ll take responsibility for our Odoo platform—the system that powers sales, order processing, logistics, and accounting.
You’ll further develop our in-house modules, continue the migration to the Odoo standard, integrate new countries, standardize payment processes, and build our new online store—ensuring it’s fully upgradeable, with streamlined workflows and genuine creative freedom.


Your mission

  • The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. In doing so, you’ll rely on an upgrade-friendly architecture based on inheritance rather than modifications to the Odoo core
  • Another key focus of your work will be migrating existing processes to the Odoo standard and integrating new countries—including localization, accounting, and country-specific requirements
  • You’ll ensure seamless and efficient payment processes by integrating PSP connections, SEPA direct debit, and PSD2/SCA, and by managing the interfaces with adjacent systems
  • Together with the relevant stakeholders, you’ll implement our new, mobile-friendly website and online store based on Odoo E-Commerce
  • You ensure code quality and testability, document architecture and design decisions, and provide technical guidance to development partners


Your profile

  • You have several years of experience in Odoo development with Python and have implemented your own modules from requirements through to go-live
  • You have worked with Odoo Enterprise in production environments—including Odoo.sh—for several years and are proficient with Git in professional development and deployment processes
  • For you, Odoo is not just a configuration tool: ORM, inheritance, Views, and QWeb, access rights, and cron jobs are all part of your skill set—ideally complemented by Odoo E-Commerce
  • You confidently analyze existing software, refactor it strategically, and further develop it with a focus on quality, maintainability, and stability
  • Experience with Odoo upgrades, data migrations, multi-company setups, or integrating payment service providers is a definite plus
  • You work in a structured and independent manner, document clearly, and communicate on an equal footing in German and English


Why us?

  • Work Environment & Organization: You enjoy working in our Munich office and value face-to-face interaction with your team. In addition, you can work from home one day a week. You’ll have the freedom to manage your own schedule within the framework of our operational requirements.

  • Modern Office: Look forward to an ergonomic workspace in Munich with a height-adjustable desk, plenty of greenery from plants, an open atmosphere, and short decision-making paths.
  • Attractive Benefits: Monthly deposits to your EmployeeCARD, subsidies for cell phone and internet service, bike leasing, car subscription, retirement savings, and more.
Please note: The application process is coordinated centrally by the ValueNet Group.


Embracing Diversity Together

At ValueNet, we actively promote diversity and equal opportunity. title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
description: What we do At Briink , we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials. Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide. We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good. Application requirement: Intro video As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering: Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you. Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;) Your role As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer , you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals. This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket. You will: Own product features end to end , from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement. Design and build scalable backend systems , including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products. Build and ship applied AI/LLM features , such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation. Improve the robustness of our systems , strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale. Work directly with users, product, and data , using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works. Prototype and test new AI capabilities , turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap. Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge , helping the team make better product and technical decisions. Collaborate closely with other engineers , including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving. Your profile Technical requirements Strong professional backend engineering experience , with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems. Experience in a small, high-ownership product team , ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers. Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end , rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation. Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly). Strong API, database, and systems design skills , with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products. Applied AI/LLM experience : you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems. A solid software-quality mindset , including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security. Cloud and container experience , with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads. Fluent English (C1+) , both written and spoken. Nice to have Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products . Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems . Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads. Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting . German language skills. Who you are Kind and collaborative : You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment. Mission-driven : You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action. Sharp and curious : You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems. A product-minded builder : You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value. Highly self-directed : You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight. Pragmatic and action-oriented : You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements. Opinionated but open-minded : You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others. Commercially aware and creative : You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed. If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection! What we offer Competitive salary and equity , reflecting your impact and ownership. Purpose-driven mission : Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent. Flexible hybrid setup : Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus. Trust and autonomy : Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows. A genuinely high-impact role : Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation. Dynamic environment : Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability. Learning budget and quarterly hackathons : Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward. raw.title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
raw.description:
What we do

At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:

  1. Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
  2. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
  3. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)


Your role

As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:

  • Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.
  • Design and build scalable backend systems, including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products.
  • Build and ship applied AI/LLM features, such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows
  • Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation.
  • Improve the robustness of our systems, strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale.
  • Work directly with users, product, and data, using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works.
  • Prototype and test new AI capabilities, turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap.
  • Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge, helping the team make better product and technical decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers, including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving.


Your profile

Technical requirements

  • Strong professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems.
  • Experience in a small, high-ownership product team, ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers.
  • Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end, rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation.
  • Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly).
  • Strong API, database, and systems design skills, with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products.
  • Applied AI/LLM experience: you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems.
  • A solid software-quality mindset, including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security.
  • Cloud and container experience, with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads.
  • Fluent English (C1+), both written and spoken. 
Nice to have
  • Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues 
  • Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks
  • Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems.
  • Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads.
  • Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting.
  • German language skills.
Who you are
  • Kind and collaborative: You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment.
  • Mission-driven: You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action.
  • Sharp and curious: You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems.
  • A product-minded builder: You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value.
  • Highly self-directed: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight.
  • Pragmatic and action-oriented: You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Opinionated but open-minded: You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others.
  • Commercially aware and creative: You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed.
If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection!


What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity, reflecting your impact and ownership.
  • Purpose-driven mission: Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent.
  • Flexible hybrid setup: Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus.
  • Trust and autonomy: Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows.
  • A genuinely high-impact role: Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation.
  • Dynamic environment: Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability.
  • Learning budget and quarterly hackathons: Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward.
  • A thoughtful hiring process: We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so.

title: Growth Lead, France
description: About the Team The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments worldwide. We work across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention and monetization, through product experiments, in-product improvements, performance marketing, creative development, and AI-powered workflows. The International Growth team works with regional leaders in priority markets to identify the user needs and product gaps that matter most for adoption, usage, and monetization. We turn country priorities into product roadmaps and growth plans, then partner with engineering, research, design, data science, marketing, finance, policy, and partnerships to test and ship improvements. We combine product strategy with hands-on growth operations. We account for local behavior, competition, and product experience while building shared capabilities such as segmentation, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation systems. We measure what ships, adapt it to the market, and scale approaches that work across markets. About the Role We’re looking for a growth lead in France to shape and execute ChatGPT’s growth plans. You’ll partner with the France GM to understand local users, identify the biggest growth opportunities, and turn those priorities into product improvements, funnel optimizations, and performance marketing tests. You’ll work across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, collaborating with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Partnerships, and Marketing teams to influence priorities and ship measurable impact. The role combines product growth and funnel optimization with performance marketing: connecting audience, message, creative, and channel learnings to better in-product journeys. In this role, you will: Partner with the France GM, regional teams, and central teams to set a country growth plan and roadmap priorities, with clear hypotheses, owners, dependencies, and measurable outcomes. Use user research, funnel and cohort data, and competitive insight to find local friction and prioritize the opportunities that matter most to users. Run performance marketing tests in collaboration with regional marketers across relevant channels, creators, and partners; use incrementally, CAC, payback, and LTV to decide what to scale. Design and run rigorous experiments across onboarding, activation, repeat usage, re-engagement, and paid conversion; measure incremental impact and iterate. Work with Product, Engineering, Design, and Data Science partners to prototype, test, and ship locally relevant experiences. Partner with regional Marketing and central media teams to brief and prioritize audience, positioning, creative, and channel tests based on the country plan. Own the country growth scorecard across acquisition, retention, paid conversion, and unit economics, distinguishing incremental user and revenue gains and learnings Connect priority use cases, product improvements, and acquisition plans into a coherent journey from first exposure to repeated value. Run the growth operating cadence with the GM and regional teams, aligning central and local partners on results, trade-offs, dependencies, and next steps. Build and operate product experimentation capabilities, segmentation, lifecycle/user journeys, performance marketing, and growth platform/tooling that can be scaled across markets. You might thrive in this role if you have: 10+ years of experience across product growth, data science, or growth strategy and operations, with hands-on execution in a fast-moving technology company. A user-first track record of turning local research and behavior into product and growth priorities, then shipping improvements with measurable impact. Strong command of acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization funnels, including technically rigorous experimentation and interpretation. Practical performance marketing experience across audience, channel, creative, and measurement decisions, and the ability to partner effectively with media specialists. Analytical fluency in cohort analysis and growth economics, including incrementality, LTV, CAC, payback, and contribution margin. Experience adapting and running campaigns across markets, using local audience behavior, channels, language, and cultural context to improve relevance and performance at scale. Experience owning growth goals and delivering measurable user or revenue outcomes across product and marketing levers. The ability to influence and align central and regional teams, translate local needs into scalable approaches, and make progress through ambiguity. title: Account Executive Manager | SMB | French Market (Paris)
description: À propos de Lexroom Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café. Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l'essentiel. Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale en France, et nous cherchons la personne qui va structurer et faire grandir l'équipe d'Account Executives. Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ? Un produit qui tient ses promesses : nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session, pas besoin de six mois de POC. Un marché en pleine effervescence : tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer. Un avantage concurrentiel fort : vous ne vendez pas un assistant IA de plus, mais une approche radicalement nouvelle que les prospects n'ont jamais vue. Un vrai rôle de bâtisseur : vous définissez les standards, les process et la culture commerciale de l'équipe dès le départ. Vos responsabilités Piloter le revenu outbound SMB : objectifs d'ARR, couverture de pipeline, taux de conversion, durée de cycle, ACV, gestion rigoureuse des remises, prévisions fiables. Manager et coacher une équipe d'AE full-cycle : 1:1 hebdomadaires, revues de pipeline, coaching sur les appels, stratégie de deals, plans d'amélioration concrets. Construire la machine outbound : segmentation ICP, découpage des territoires, stratégie de sourcing des comptes, prospection multicanale (téléphone, email, LinkedIn), standards de cadence et suivi activité → résultats. Recruter, onboarder et faire monter en compétence les AE, avec un plan de ramp-up et des jalons clairs. Gérer la performance : attentes claires, rituels hebdomadaires (WBR), diagnostic des causes (compétence, motivation, territoire, message) et action rapide en cas de sous-performance. Collaborer avec le Marketing (campagnes, contenus, événements), les Partenariats (canaux locaux, KOLs) et le Produit (remontée des insights terrain). Garantir la discipline process et outils : CRM irréprochable, séquences rigoureuses, reporting fiable. Les faits avant les impressions. Profil recherché Expérience confirmée en management commercial outbound SMB dans le SaaS B2B, avec une équipe d'AE full-cycle atteignant régulièrement ses objectifs. Expertise terrain : vous savez vous-même lancer des séquences, faire du cold call et enseigner une prospection qui convertit. Mindset de coach : vous identifiez rapidement les écarts de performance et coachez de façon structurée (écoute d'appels, scorecards), pas avec des discours de motivation génériques. Profil data-driven : à l'aise avec la funnel math (activité → meetings → démos → essais → closing), le forecast et la couverture de pipeline. Maîtrise des outils : CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), outils de séquençage et d'automatisation, Sales Navigator, et une vraie exigence sur la qualité des données. Français natif, anglais courant (clientèle francophone, équipes internes internationales). Intérêt pour le droit : une expérience dans le secteur juridique ou des services professionnels est un plus, mais pas indispensable. Ce que nous offrons Rémunération fixe: 70 000 € + bonus sur performance Equity Mutuelle Alan, titres-restaurant, accès Wellpass (sport et bien-être) Travail hybride, bureaux à Paris Team retreats et off-sites Processus de recrutement Entretien Talent Acquisition : motivation et parcours. Entretien avec le hiring manager : expérience de management et approche commerciale. Business case : construction d'un plan outbound et gestion d'une situation de performance. Entretien final : valeurs et culture. Offre. Compensation: €70K – €110K • Offers Equity • €70K – €110K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
