description:
The Robotics & Mechatronics Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a C++ Software Engineer (m/f/d) Platform Infrastructure, who will help build and maintain the C++ platform infrastructure our robot runs on. You will help us ensure it runs reliably and safely once it is out of the lab and in production.

Responsibilities

  • Platform Development: Develop and maintain modern C++ software components for the robot's Linux-based platform infrastructure.
  • Communication & IPC: Build and maintain the IPC and communication interfaces that connect robot applications, backend services, and hardware-facing components.
  • Debugging & Diagnostics: Debug concurrency, timing, memory, performance, and system-integration issues across the platform.
  • Testing Infrastructure: Build unit, integration, and hardware-oriented test infrastructure for platform components.
  • Reliability & Observability: Improve system reliability through better diagnostics, logging, fault handling, and recovery mechanisms.
  • Hardware Integration: Test and integrate software on real robotic hardware, working with firmware, control, backend, QA, and DevOps engineers when problems cross those boundaries.

Essential Skills

  • Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience, with initial professional experience building production C++ software, typically up to about three years and excluding internships or working-student positions.
  • Modern C++: Hands-on experience writing C++ using modern practices (C++17/C++20), gained through professional work, internships, or substantial project experience.
  • Systems Programming: Working understanding of Linux system programming — processes, threads, synchronization, IPC, and sockets — along with asynchronous programming concepts.
  • Debugging: Practical debugging experience using tools such as GDB, sanitizers (ASan/TSan/UBSan), or Valgrind, applied to problems that span multiple interacting software or hardware components.
  • Testing: Experience writing automated tests with frameworks such as GoogleTest, including meaningful unit and integration test coverage.

Beneficial Skills

  • Robotics & Industrial Background: Experience with robotics, industrial automation, or embedded systems, including industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, CAN, or similar.
  • Hardware-in-the-Loop Testing: Experience with hardware-in-the-loop, simulation, fault-injection, or other automated system-testing approaches.
  • Embedded Linux: Experience with real-time or performance-sensitive Linux systems, or with the deployment side of embedded Linux.
  • Python Tooling: Experience using Python for testing, automation, or developer tooling.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Experience using AI-assisted development tools, combined with critically reviewing and validating the generated output.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. Role

We are looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) to join our team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Director, Technical Marketing Engineer in the Product Management department. We are seeking a hands-on, self-starting Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) with deep networking expertise to drive technical enablement, customer validation, and field readiness for our next-generation Zero Trust Branch solutions. In this high-impact role, you will architect and maintain complex lab environments, lead hands-on Proof of Value (PoV) customer engagements, and provide technical troubleshooting to resolve escalations. As the bridge between engineering and field teams, you will author comprehensive deployment guides, technical collateral, and test plans while delivering interactive training to systems engineers and partners. This is an ideal position for a practitioner who thrives on solving real-world enterprise networking challenges and accelerating customer adoption across distributed edge environments.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead Customer Proof of Value (PoV) Engagements & Field Validations by directly owning and executing hands-on technical PoVs, architectural demonstrations, and pilot evaluations with enterprise prospects and customers to validate technical capabilities, eliminate sales friction, and accelerate enterprise deal closure

  • Architect, Build, and Maintain Advanced Lab Topologies by designing, deploying, and maintaining resilient physical and virtual networking lab environments simulating complex enterprise branch, edge, retail network topologies to rigorously test product behavior, interoperability, and real-world scale

  • Drive Complex Technical Troubleshooting & Escalation Resolution by serving as the direct technical escalation bridge between field teams and core engineering to diagnose, reproduce, and resolve critical L2/L3 networking escalations, network segmentation challenges, and packet-level anomalies during active customer pilots

  • Author Technical Documentation, Deployment Guides, and Reference Architectures by developing production-ready technical collateral, including step-by-step deployment runbooks, reference architectures, white papers, competitive test plans, and solution briefs to standardize best practices and accelerate post-sales time-to-value

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • Operate with a strong ownership mindset, combining a passion for the mission with high integrity and the ability to navigate seamlessly between strategic planning and hands-on execution.

  • Maintain a customer-obsessed approach, building deep empathy for internal and external stakeholders to solve real-world problems and champion their success.

  • Move with a strong sense of urgency, focusing on execution and delivering high-impact, high-quality results rapidly in a growth-oriented environment.

  • Drive innovation through deep curiosity, enjoying complex technical challenges and leveraging technology to build secure, scalable solutions.

  • Lead with integrity and accountability, consistently aligning actions with words to build trust across teams.

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in technical marketing, solutions architecture, or advanced systems engineering with deep subject matter expertise in enterprise routing, switching, TCP/IP, L2/L3 network segmentation, and tunneling protocols (WireGuard, IPsec, VxLAN)

  • Proven track record of leading and winning hands-on customer Proof of Value (PoV) pilots and executive architectural evaluations within complex enterprise and distributed edge networking environments

  • Hands-on proficiency in building and maintaining multi-vendor physical and virtual network lab topologies using bare-metal appliances, hypervisors (ESXi, KVM), and network emulation platforms (EVE-NG, GNS3)

  • Advanced packet analysis and troubleshooting expertise using Wireshark, tcpdump, and traffic generation tools to diagnose real-time routing anomalies, latency/jitter, MTU issues, and NAT/firewall traversal

  • Demonstrated track record of authoring production-grade technical collateral (deployment runbooks, reference architectures, white papers) and delivering technical enablement sessions to sales engineering, professional services, and partner teams

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

  • Practical experience with Python, Bash scripting, or infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs) to automate lab deployment, test execution, and repetitive networking workflows

  • Working knowledge of public cloud networking architectures (AWS VPCs/Transit Gateways, Azure Virtual WAN, GCP Cloud Routers) or container networking environments (Docker, Kubernetes) connecting distributed branch edges to cloud workloads

  • Recognized networking or security certifications (e.g., CCIE/CCNP Enterprise or Security, JNCIP, PCNSE) or direct architectural experience with retail, kiosk, IoT/OT, or cellular WAN/5G failover deployments

Von deiner Arbeit hängt ab, ob unsere Produkte in den Regalen der größten Drogerieketten verfügbar sind. Das sind wir! Du führst unsere Hersteller in Asien und Europa durch Auftragsbestätigung, Produktion, Qualitätsprüfung vor Verschiffung und Versanddokumente. Bei Verzug eskalierst du früh und bringst eine Lösung mit. Du misst Lieferantenleistung über eine Scorecard (Termintreue, Qualität, Reaktionszeit) und machst Abweichungen sichtbar, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Du steuerst mit Finance Anzahlungen und Fälligkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Zertifikate und Konformitätsnachweise unserer Lieferanten vollständig vorliegen. Was du mitbringst: Du hast mehrere Jahre operative Beschaffung mit Herstellern in Asien eigenverantwortlich gesteuert, idealerweise für eine Konsumgütermarke mit Handelsbelieferung. Du arbeitest genau, weil du ein System dafür hast, nicht weil du langsam bist. Du kannst zeigen, wie du Fehler abfängst, bevor eine Bestellung rausgeht. Du führst Lieferanten freundlich und hartnäckig, auch über Zeitzonen hinweg, und bleibst dran, bis ein Termin wirklich steht. Du wartest nicht auf Anweisung. Erfahrung mit Pre-Shipment-Inspections bzw. QC-Dienstleistern. Was wir dir bieten: 🇪🇺 100 % Remote in Deutschland: Remote-first mit optionalem Büro in Berlin. title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Our Opportunity Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate. Your Mission As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver. You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath. You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo. Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties. Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome What you'll own Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver. Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact. Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am. Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access. Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable. Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure. Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job. What success looks like You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use. Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why. You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it. You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you. You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how. What it takes You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement. You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast. You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows. You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy. You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration. You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem. You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers. You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them. Bonus: AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC. LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows. Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning. Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it. Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard. Why Predium? Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit. Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product. Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both. Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create. Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week. 30 vacation days (including company vacation) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · team events Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Data Scientist at Predium, you will help develop and improve the data-driven models behind our platform. You will use statistics, machine learning, and numerical methods to solve well-defined problems related to buildings, energy performance, and real-estate decarbonization.
Working closely with our engineering and product team, you will turn real-world data into reliable analytical, simulation, and machine-learning models that identify optimization opportunities for more sustainable buildings and help customers make informed investment decisions.


What you'll own

  1. Develop and improve analytical, machine-learning, and simulation models to address business problems in the real-estate and energy domain.
  2. Build and improve data extraction pipelines for structured and unstructured sources, evaluating extraction accuracy and reliability
  3. Continuously explore and evaluate new data sources to improve model accuracy.
  4. Assess data quality, identify gaps and evaluate model performance by validating assumptions and results against real-world data and feedback of domain experts.
  5. Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven solutions.


What success looks like

  1. You take ownership of well-defined analytical and modeling problems and independently deliver robust solutions.
  2. Your models and analyses are reproducible, well-documented, and supported by appropriate validation.
  3. You translate technical results into clear implications for the product, our customers, and the business.
  4. You collaborate effectively across Data, Engineering and Product teams.
  5. You actively seek feedback and use it to improve both your technical work and your way of working.


What it takes

  1. A degree in data science, computer science, mathematics or a related field.
  2. 1–2 years of relevant hands-on experience, with programming, ideally in Python, through projects in areas such as physics-based modeling, machine learning, or data pipelines. TypeScript experience for product prototyping is a plus.
  3. A structured, independent approach to problem-solving.
  4. Curiosity about business needs and the ability to explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  5. Confident communication in English and German.
Bonus:
  1. Initial experience with optimization methods, LLM-based data extraction, or uncertainty and sensitivity analysis.
  2. Familiarity with real estate, building physics, or energy systems.
  3. Experience with tools for physical simulation or energy modeling.


Why Predium?

  • Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. The models you build feed straight into our product and get used by real customers. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.

  • Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.

Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und bringst eine hohe Lernbereitschaft mit. Du kommunizierst gerne, arbeitest teamorientiert und hast Spaß daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Was wünschenswert wäre Erste Kenntnisse im IT Service Management (ITSM), z. B. Incident-, Request- oder Change-Management Erste Erfahrungen mit Prozessdarstellungen, Flowcharts oder ähnlichen Methoden Interesse an Generative AI, Copilot, Atlassian Intelligence oder vergleichbaren Technologien Erste Berührungspunkte mit Projekt-, Prozess- oder Service Management. Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Ticket- und Collaboration-Tools (z. B. Jira oder Confluence). Erste Kenntnisse im Bereich Prozessmodellierung, Reporting oder Datenanalyse. Interesse an Themen wie KI-gestütztem Wissensmanagement, Automatisierung oder Continuous Improvement. Was wir dir bieten Modernes, zentral gelegenes Büro im Münchner Werksviertel. Einen spannenden Einblick in die digitale Produktlandschaft des Volkswagen Konzerns. Von Anfang an Verantwortung, Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen. Vereinbarkeit von Arbeit und Privatleben durch flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work. Regelmäßiges Feedback und Unterstützung bei deiner persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. Teamevents, interne Veranstaltungen und die Möglichkeit, dein Netzwerk auszubauen. Bewerbung Bitte bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf, Anschreiben (optional) und Zeugnissen über unser Karriereportal. description: Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Platform & Reliability Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich). As a Platform & Reliability Engineer at Contabo, you take architectural ownership of our shared infrastructure services – the foundation that multiple development teams build on: API gateway and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress), persistent storage (Ceph, Longhorn), secrets and identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), edge security and WAF (Cloudflare), and our observability stack. You'll be taking over grown, partially under-documented systems – and that's exactly where the appeal of this role lies: you work your way deep into these systems, identify and remediate known weak points, evaluate aging components with solution-agnostic build-vs-buy reasoning, and decide which legacy pieces get fixed, replaced, or retired. In parallel, you mature our observability practices, rolling out distributed tracing, SLOs/SLIs, and meaningful dashboards across the stack, building on our existing tooling with Prometheus, Grafana, Alloy, and OpenTelemetry. In system design reviews, you bring your strong grounding in the fundamentals – load balancing, caching, sharding, replication, consistency trade-offs – and apply them to new and existing services alike. You won't be managing a team, but you will be the technical authority multiple teams rely on: you advise across teams on shared infrastructure services, document your knowledge consistently, and actively distribute it – so that critical know-how never again depends on a single person. title: Accounting Manager
description:
ANINE BING is looking for an Accounting Manager to join our Finance team based in Paris.

This role is an opportunity to help shape the next chapter of ANINE BING. As a key contributor within our Paris HQ team, the Accounting Manager brings both strategic insight and hands-on execution to their work — supporting our global growth while staying grounded in the brand's DNA: refined, fast-moving, and always evolving.

We're looking for a senior, hands-on accounting professional who thrives in a creative yet performance-driven environment. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting expertise with a project management mindset, a genuine sensitivity to Finance × IT topics (AP automation, ERP improvements), and a structured, team-oriented approach. They are rigorous, organized, and energized by leading a team and building scalable accounting processes across an international footprint.

Reporting to the Global Accounting Director, the Accounting Manager owns the day-to-day accounts payable and general accounting operations across our directly-managed entities — France, the UK, the US and other EU markets. The role manages a team of three (AP Accountant, General Accountant, and Intern) and acts as the operational anchor of the accounting team, ensuring clean books, timely closes and strong vendor relationships. The role is expected to operate as a true business partner to all operational departments, not as a back-office function.

This is a hybrid position based at our Paris HQ, with one remote day per week (Wednesday or Friday). The role reports to the Accounting & Tax Director.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Own the end-to-end accounts payable process across all directly-managed entities: vendor onboarding, invoice processing, payment runs, expense reports, and vendor relationship management.
  • Lead the general accounting operations: journal entries, bank reconciliations, fixed assets, accruals, prepayments, and intercompany bookings — ensuring accurate, timely month-end and year-end closes.
  • Manage and develop a team of three (AP Accountant, General Accountant, Intern): set priorities, coach, review work and build technical depth within the team.
  • Partner with the Accounting & Tax Director on the design and implementation of accounting policies, internal controls and process improvements.
  • Lead Finance × IT initiatives within scope: AP automation tools, ERP improvements, expense management systems and approval workflows.
  • Support statutory audits and tax filings by preparing required schedules, reconciliations and supporting documentation across entities.
  • Act as a true business partner to Operations, Procurement, Retail and HQ teams — building trust, anticipating needs and ensuring smooth vendor management.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in accounting, including at least 2 years managing a team of accountants in an international, multi-entity environment.
  • Senior profile with a strong hands-on mindset: comfortable balancing managerial responsibilities with direct, detailed accounting work.
  • Strong technical command of French GAAP; exposure to US GAAP or IFRS is a plus.
  • Solid hands-on expertise across AP and general accounting: full close cycle, reconciliations, intercompany, accruals.
  • Proven project management mindset and Finance × IT sensitivity: experience leading process and system improvements (ERP rollouts, AP automation, expense management tools).
  • Genuine business partner mindset, with the ability to engage and collaborate effectively with all operational departments.
  • Proven people management skills — including hiring, coaching, and developing junior accountants and interns.
  • Fluent English required; French is a strong asset. Comfortable operating across time zones, including with US-based teams.
  • Experience in retail, fashion, e-commerce or consumer goods is a strong plus.

Benefits & Perks

  • HQ FRANCE: At ANINE BING Paris, we combine creative ambition with a people-first culture. Expect generous time off (including RTT), a hybrid schedule with one remote day per week, exclusive discounts on our collections, and private sales access — so you can live the brand as much as you build it.
  • Style Perks: Enjoy a generous employee discount and seasonal wardrobe allotments — so you can live the brand, not just represent it.
  • Performance Bonus: Eligibility for an annual performance bonus of 10% of base salary, tied to close quality, process improvements and team development.

The target gross annual base salary for this role is between €70,000 and €85,000, depending on experience, with eligibility for an annual performance bonus of 10%.

Working at ANINE BING

ANINE BING seeks to empower its employees by providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Diversity and inclusion is critical to our success as a global brand, and we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

More about ANINE BING

ANINE BING is a Los Angeles-based fashion house founded in 2012 that blends elements of Scandinavian simplicity with American energy to offer modern wardrobe essentials for women seeking a timeless yet rebellious approach to everyday style. Since its launch, ANINE BING has evolved into a global brand, available in over 90 countries with a growing network of brick-and-mortar retail stores in key cities worldwide.

Powered by a global team of over 250 employees, ANINE BING is headquartered in Los Angeles and Paris, with additional offices in New York and Shanghai.

About Our Paris HQ

Located just off the Champs-Élysées, our Paris headquarters at 1 Rue François 1er is a cornerstone of our international growth. As the home of our Product teams and other key functions, this space reflects our commitment to creativity, collaboration, and global perspective. As we continue to grow across Europe, our Paris office plays a central role in shaping the future of our brand.

  • Élévation de la culture & des pratiques produit

raw.title: Senior IT Engineer
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Mission

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to 2-3 days a month on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next.

Scope

⚙️ Platform & automation

  • Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

  • Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

  • Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access

  • Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

  • Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

  • Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

  • Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

  • Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

  • Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

  • Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT

  • The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

  • Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation

  • Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones

First 3 months

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

  • Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

  • Own a workstream end-to-end

  • Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

  • Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

  • Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

  • Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

  • Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

  • Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

  • Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

  • 5+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering, with real ownership of production-facing systems

  • Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it.

  • You write code: not necessarily as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

  • Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

  • Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

  • Automation & AI appetite: uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

  • Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

  • Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

  • Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

  • Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform

  • Kandji or another MDM at scale

  • Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

  • Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, HDS)

  • Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

  • Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

  • Health or healthtech ecosystem familiarity

Languages: Fluent English & Professional French

We are expanding our talent network and seeking skilled Wolof-language professionals with expertise in user interfaces, marketing localization, and retail content. Our ideal partners possess a nuanced command of market-specific nuances and consumer expectations. We value linguists who excel at software localization and brand storytelling, ensuring every string is clear, consistent, and culturally impactful.

What You'll Deliver

  • Precision in UX and Technical Content. Adapt complex software interfaces and support documentation with total accuracy, ensuring terminological rigor and a seamless experience for native Wolof users.

  • Impactful Marketing Localization. Transform global campaigns and brand voices to hit home in the Wolof-speaking market, maintaining the original creative spirit while maximizing local relevance.

  • Polished Product and E-commerce Copy. Localize product and UI listings applying regional naming logic and formatting standards.

  • Brand Integrity and Quality Assurance. Uphold elite quality benchmarks to provide engaging, audience-centric content aligned with brand identity.

  • Agile Team Collaboration. Coordinate with our production and quality leads to execute high-stakes projects on schedule and within client specifications.

Qualifications

  • Native-level proficiency in Wolof.

  • A graduate qualification in translation, linguistics, or language studies, OR a graduate qualification in another field plus 2 years of full-time professional translation experience, OR 5 years of full-time professional translation experience.

  • The ability to follow terminology and reference materials precisely.

  • Proven professional experience in translation and localization within marketing, UI/software, or e-commerce content.

  • Experience with app or platform localization (mobile UI, social media, or web content) preferred.

Why Collaborate with LILT?

  • Your schedule, your rules. As an independent contractor, work when you want, as much or as little as you want. No fixed hours, no check-ins, no micromanaging.

  • Get paid quickly and fairly. Competitive rates, prompt payments, no chasing invoices.

  • Work on projects that actually matter. Contribute to cutting-edge AI and language technology shaping how humans and machines communicate.

  • Be part of something bigger. Join a global community of linguists, subject matter experts, and language professionals advancing human knowledge together.

  • Grow without limits. Access diverse, innovative projects that expand your portfolio and sharpen your skills across industries and domains.

  • Have fun doing what you love. Bring your language skills to life on projects that are as interesting as they are impactful.

What to Consider Before Applying

  • Not ideal as a full-time job or primary income source. Work availability fluctuates with project demand; as a 1099 contractor, you won't receive benefits such as health insurance, paid time off, or retirement contributions, and hours are not guaranteed.

  • Requires reliable availability and commitment. Most tasks require a minimum of 2 hours per day or 10 hours per week.

  • Geographic restrictions may apply. We cannot engage contractors in regions subject to international embargo or sanctions. As a 1099 contractor, you are solely responsible for your own tax obligations.

How to Join Our Expert Community

  1. Submit your application, including an updated copy of your CV in English.

  2. If a test is required, you will be asked to take a test in the domain(s) you specialize in.

  3. Once selected and you've passed the test, we'll guide you through onboarding — completing an application form, getting you set up for payments, and welcoming you into our community.

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

LILT's mission is to make the world's information available to everyone, no matter the language they speak. Join our global community who thrive on innovation and excellence. Our collective knowledge, uniqueness, and skills deliver multilingual AI and human-verified services to Enterprises, Governments, and AI Developers around the world.

Earn money. Have fun. Advance human knowledge. Work on diverse projects from anywhere, any time you want. Get paid quickly and fairly, and build your professional network in a supportive community—all through a streamlined application process tailored to your expertise.

Information collected and processed as part of your application process, including any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to LILT's Privacy Policy at https://lilt.com/legal/privacy.

As part of our recruitment efforts, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) and automated tools to assist in the evaluation of applications, including résumé screening, assessment scoring, and interview analysis. These tools are designed to support human decision-making and help us identify qualified candidates efficiently and objectively. All final hiring decisions are made by people. title: Account Associate - Retail & Grocery (H/F)
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de transformer la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses. Chez Deliveroo, impact, innovation et croissance sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les livreurs partenaires pour donner à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elle veut, comme elle le veut, quand elle le veut et où elle le veut. Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre! Ce que vous ferez au quotidien En tant que Account Associate - Retail & Grocery (H/F) , vous serez responsable du succès d'un portefeuille de partenaires, afin d'assurer la meilleure expérience à nos utilisateurs, tout en construisant un partenariat solide et durable avec nos eux pour notre application. Analysez la performance de votre portefeuille et prenez les mesures adéquates, faites des recommandations, soyez agile et ouvert à la nouveauté. Optimisation et gestion de Processus : Deliveroo est une société qui évolue à grande vitesse et à grande échelle. Vous aurez l'opportunité de créer et améliorer des processus, par exemple la gestion de partenariats pour contribuer à la croissance. Vous élaborerez des documents de meilleures pratiques pour des comptes spécifiques et pour l'ensemble du portefeuille Relations avec les magasins Retail et/ou Grocery : Vous gérerez le développement des partenariats, le suivi des données, et vous assurerez une expérience optimale sur l'application afin de faire de Deliveroo le service de livraison à domicile de référence, en apportant votre expertise Food Tech en étant l'expert de votre zone / ville. Vous veillerez au suivi du respect des engagements contractuels pris avec les partenaires de votre portefeuille. Ce qu'il vous faut pour réussir Expérience : stage ou alternance dans un rôle d'Account management ou commercial. Une expérience terrain au sein d'un grand groupe (idéalement supermarché, marketplace, ecommerce, retailer, FMCG) est un vrai atout. Commercial : vous avez à cœur de négocier, d'anticiper des discussions commerciales, d'entreprendre des actions afin de maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociations de mise en place d'outils commerciaux, etc) Entrepreneur : vous avez le goût pour entreprendre, créer, aller chercher des opportunités, en sachant prendre de la hauteur mais sans jamais se couper du terrain et de votre téléphone pour comprendre vos partenaires. Analytique : capable d'être synthétique, d'approfondir les données et de comprendre les données qui permettent d'améliorer les performances pour nos partenaires en magasins. Proactif(-ive) dans vos relations avec les interlocuteurs. Vous adorez être sur le terrain et vous êtes impliqué(e) dans tout ce qui est opérationnel dans votre périmètre. Centré sur le client : être obsédé par nos clients. Utiliser des données quantitatives et qualitatives pour construire un service qui soit opérationnellement excellent pour nos clients. Jouer en équipe : un joueur d'équipe qui collabore et qui est capable de tirer le meilleur parti des personnes qui vous entourent. Capable de travailler efficacement à tous les niveaux de Deliveroo et de réussir avec et par les autres. Optimiste, confiant et plein d'énergie : vous apportez de la fraîcheur, de l'énergie et de la passion dans l'équipe. Vous contribuez à créer un environnement de travail unique, propice aux nouvelles idées et agréable pour les autres personnes impliquées. Langues : Français et Anglais courant indispensables. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Nous sommes des passionnés de food, des problem-solvers, des créateurs de communauté et bien plus encore. Ce qui nous rassemble : un esprit entrepreneurial fort et l'envie de construire quelque chose d'ambitieux ensemble. 🔧 Une grande autonomie pour avoir un impact concret sur votre portefeuille et nos partenaires. 🌱 Un environnement stimulant favorisant l'apprentissage, le développement et l'évolution de carrière. 💙 Des avantages pensés pour le bien-être et l'équilibre de nos équipes. 🌍 Une culture inclusive, internationale et collaborative où chacun peut trouver sa place. À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. Prêt(e) à contribuer au futur de la foodtech ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui ! Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness . title: Senior Business Analyst – Financial Crime Compliance & Market Conduct
description:
Joining Capco means becoming part of an innovative and dynamic consultancy firm, committed to fostering an inclusive environment where you are encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. We embrace individuality as a key factor in promoting diversity and inclusion, values that sit at the core of our success. We aim to attract a wide variety of talented professionals with different skills and experiences. If you require any adjustments to support your application process, please feel free to inform us at any stage.

ABOUT CAPCO

Capco is a global technology and business consultancy that is passionate about supporting clients in the financial services sector to grow and succeed in today's ever-changing world. We are:

  • Experts in banking, capital markets, payments and asset and wealth management.
  • Trusted advisors in core banking, securities and wealth management transformation, regulatory change, risk management and technology modernization.
  • A company dedicated to continuous development and excited to welcome top talent to help us drive innovation and deliver lasting results.
  • A business built on agility, collaboration, and entrepreneurial spirit.

THE ROLE

 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to help shape the strategic transformation of our Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) and Market Conduct & Trade Surveillance (MCTS) capabilities within Legal & Compliance.

Working at the intersection of compliance, business, technology, architecture and data, you will shape strategic target states, assess current capabilities and translate business and control objectives into prioritised transformation roadmaps and actionable requirements. You will facilitate complex cross-functional decisions and provide clear recommendations to senior management.

You will act as the senior business-analysis and transformation lead for selected FCC and MCTS initiatives, shaping target states and roadmaps while working in close partnership with Compliance, Technology, Architecture, Data and Programme Management.

YOUR CAPCO DAY

  • Lead the business definition of strategic target states, facilitating alignment across Compliance, Technology, Architecture and Data and ensuring that agreed target states are translated into actionable transformation plans.
  • Assess current capabilities and conduct gap analyses across processes, organisation, systems, architecture, data quality and governance, translating findings into prioritised transformation measures and investment considerations.
  • Define business and technology requirements and develop relevant use cases and options, including opportunities to improve data quality, reduce false positives, automate and scale alert handling, and strengthen monitoring and surveillance processes.
  • Translate target states into structured multi-year transformation roadmaps, defining priorities, milestones, dependencies, sequencing, responsibilities, investment considerations and key trade-offs across risk reduction, regulatory need, business value and delivery feasibility. Facilitate cross-functional decision-making across business, technology and control functions, frame key options and trade-offs, and prepare concise recommendations and decision materials for senior management. Define measurable transformation outcomes and success criteria, such as improved control effectiveness, reduced manual effort and false positives, better data quality and lineage, increased automation, and improved operational scalability.
  • Ensure traceability from regulatory, policy and control objectives through business requirements, solution design and implementation outcomes.

YOUR CAPCO FIT

  • Demonstrated Financial Crime Compliance expertise combined with project and ideally consulting experience in the design and digital transformation of FCC solutions within a comparable financial-services environment.
  • Strong ability to work across business architecture, solution/enterprise architecture and data disciplines, translating business and control requirements into architectural, process and data implications.” Strong expertise in Financial Crime Compliance, with deep experience in one or more core domains such as AML/CTF, sanctions or PEP screening, and sufficient breadth to work effectively across adjacent FCC areas including tax compliance.Proven change and organisational capabilities, particularly stakeholder management and facilitation, Target Operating Model definition and the preparation of decision materials for senior management.
  • Strong conceptual and analytical capabilities, with experience translating strategic target states into prioritised multi-year roadmaps and implementation plans within complex transformation environments.
  • Fluent English and German are a must for this role. 

BONUS POINTS FOR

  • Experience within Market Conduct, Trade Surveillance or comparable monitoring and surveillance environments; deep MCTS expertise is advantageous but not required where the candidate brings strong transferable FCC transformation experience.
  • Experience developing strategic concepts spanning Financial Crime Compliance, Legal & Compliance and wider banking transformation.
  • Familiarity with surveillance challenges such as false-positive reduction, alert management, data quality and the integration of relevant communications and market information.
  • Experience assessing investment requirements and prioritising transformation initiatives across three-to-five-year roadmaps.
  • Experience coordinating transformation plans with wider enterprise architecture, technology or bank-wide strategic programmes.

 

Ready to take the Next Step 

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you. This is an opportunity to make a difference and contribute to a highly successful company with a significant growth trajectory.

title: Senior Licensing Manager
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Licensing Manager – UEFA will play a critical role in strategically growing and leading the UEFA Masterlicense business unit.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Senior Licensing Manager – UEFA serves as the senior lead for the UEFA Masterlicense business, owning client and licensee relationships while ensuring operational and financial objectives are met with precision and efficiency. This role partners closely with senior leadership to develop and execute strategic licensing plans that maximize revenue, position client brands appropriately, and identify new business opportunities across the European licensing landscape. The Director, Licensing – UEFA delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

 

HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Communicate division strategy clearly across licensing, legal, finance, and operations teams to ensure cohesive execution against the UEFA Masterlicense program's goals and objectives.
  • Partner with senior leadership to report key business results to corporate officers and align divisional priorities with enterprise-wide strategic initiatives.
  • Coordinate with Finance on royalty reporting and royalty accounting, and with Legal on contract drafting and negotiation, ensuring seamless cross-functional delivery.

 

People Leadership:

  • Lead and direct the UEFA licensing business unit, setting performance goals for direct reports and providing ongoing evaluation against the group's objectives.
  • Develop team members through clear expectations, coaching, and alignment to BOLD leadership principles to build a high-performing licensing organization.

 

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

  • Build and maintain meaningful, trust-based relationships with UEFA and all licensing clients, key stakeholders, business partners, and strategic alliances to advance each client's licensing program.
  • Maintain an in-depth working knowledge of all Fanatics Licensing Management (FLM) clients to proactively anticipate needs and deliver consistently high levels of service.
  • Oversee day-to-day management of client licensing programs — including contract negotiation and royalty reporting — ensuring clients receive accurate, timely, and strategic partnership support.
  • Represent FLM at industry licensing trade shows and participate in business sessions with leading licensees to strengthen relationships and elevate the Fanatics brand in the European market.

 

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

  • Assist in identifying new business opportunities that align with high-quality business strategies and support both short-term and long-term objectives of the UEFA licensing program.
  • Work with the senior leadership team to develop and implement innovative strategic licensing plans that position client brands competitively and maximize licensing revenue.
  • Continuously evaluate operational and logistics processes within the licensing business unit, identifying improvements that drive greater efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Stay connected to industry trends and competitive dynamics in the European sports licensing landscape, bringing forward-thinking perspectives to client and business strategy.

 

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

  • Own the day-to-day management of the P&L for the UEFA licensing business unit, ensuring the division achieves its strategic and financial objectives.
  • Oversee the development of annual reports for clients, delivering accurate and insightful performance summaries that inform future licensing strategy.

 

  • Manage competing priorities and complex stakeholder relationships simultaneously, operating with exceptional attention to detail and a self-starter mindset in a fast-paced environment.
  • Take full accountability for divisional results, driving a culture of relentless execution and continuous improvement across all licensing operations.

 

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

  • Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
  • Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
  • Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

 

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in the licensing industry, with demonstrated expertise in managing licensing programs, client relationships, and contractual obligations.
  • 5+ years of experience in customer and client relations, with a proven ability to build and sustain strategic partnerships at a senior level.
  • 3+ years of management experience, including directing teams and evaluating performance against defined business objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a business unit P&L and deliver against financial and strategic targets.
  • Experience in contract negotiation and working cross-functionally with Legal and Finance teams on licensing agreements and royalty processes.
  • Motivated self-starter with the ability to excel at multi-tasking in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office; strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present key results to senior and corporate leadership.

 

Education:

Bachelor's degree required.

 

WORK LOCATION

On-site: Your work location will be onsite in Paris or Manchester.

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset—We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined & Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

ABOUT US
Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, www.fanatics.com.

Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).

At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:
· Build Championship Teams
· Obsessed with Fans
· Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit
· Determined and Relentless Mindset

Portalp est spécialisée dans la conception, la fabrication, la pose et la maintenance de portes automatiques piétonnes depuis 60 ans maintenant.

  • Nos plus : Mutuelle, CSE, Carte tickets restaurant 9,50 € par jour travaillé (60% part employeur), Prime CP

Vous cherchez une entreprise dans le cadre d’une formation en alternance en Bac+2 /+ 3 en relation clients ou commerce.

o   Un environnement de travail passionnant, une atmosphère de travail qui vous donne la possibilité de développer votre potentiel et d’évoluer en interne.

Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Logiciel Full Stack & IoT pour participer au développement et à l'évolution d'une plateforme permettant de collecter, traiter, superviser et exploiter les données issues d'équipements connectés . Connecter et exploiter les équipements Interconnecter les équipements connectés et les systèmes d'information. Assurer la collecte, le traitement et l'historisation des données. Travailler sur les communications IoT et la supervision des équipements. Contribuer à l'interopérabilité avec les systèmes existants, notamment ERP et GMAO. Innover Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités d'automatisation. Explorer les usages des LLM et agents IA , notamment pour l'assistance à la maintenance et l'exploitation des données. Être force de proposition sur les évolutions techniques et fonctionnelles de la plateforme. Analyser et concevoir Recueillir et analyser les besoins. Traduire les besoins fonctionnels en solutions techniques. Participer aux choix d'architecture et aux décisions techniques. Documenter et accompagner la mise en production des solutions. Votre environnement technique 🔑 Incontournables Front-End : React, Angular ou Vue.js, JavaScript / TypeScript Back-End : Node.js / NestJS, API REST IoT : MQTT, TCP/IP, HTTPS, équipements connectés Bases de données : MongoDB, SQL Server et/ou PostgreSQL Infrastructure : Linux, Docker, Load Balancing, scalabilité et performance Architecture & intégration : interconnexion de systèmes et ERP / GMAO ⭐ Différenciants WebSocket, Python / FastAPI, microservices Azure / AWS, Nginx, monitoring OAuth2 / JWT, OWASP, TLS / SSL Grafana / Power BI LLM, agents IA et automatisation de workflows Analyse fonctionnelle et gestion de projet Vous ne maîtrisez pas l'ensemble de ces technologies ? Ce n'est pas un frein. Nous recherchons avant tout une solide expertise sur les fondamentaux, une vision globale des systèmes et une réelle capacité d'adaptation. Votre profil De formation supérieure en informatique, ingénierie logicielle ou domaine équivalent, vous disposez idéalement de 5 ans d'expérience ou plus en développement logiciel. Vous êtes capable de prendre en charge un sujet de l'analyse jusqu'à la mise en production , et appréciez les environnements où il faut comprendre le système dans sa globalité plutôt que travailler sur une seule brique technique. Une expérience dans un environnement IoT industriel, systèmes connectés, supervision d'équipements ou plateforme SaaS sera particulièrement appréciée. Pourquoi rejoindre ce projet ? Ce poste vous permet d'intervenir sur un périmètre technique particulièrement riche : Équipements connectés → IoT → données → Back-End → bases de données → infrastructure → sécurité → plateforme web → automatisation → IA. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services. Our remote-first, global team develops open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot , Polkadot SDK , and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications. About the Team This role sits in our Acceleration department, home to the people who drive ecosystem growth by building tools, integrations, and partnerships across the Polkadot network. Reporting into our Polkadot Research Lead, you’ll be joining the Polkadot Research Engineering team. We shape the Polkadot research vision and roadmap, translating ecosystem needs into tools and experiences that accelerate platform adoption. About the Role As a Senior Experience Engineer , you will lead the end-to-end delivery of features, from initial problem discovery to production deployment. This role is designed for a self-directed builder who prioritizes "what" to build as much as "how" to build it. What you’ll do Full-Lifecycle Ownership: Lead feature development through scoping, architecture, deployment, and iteration based on live user data. Strong product intuition for applying AI to solve real user problems and ship features that deliver genuine value. About Working With Us Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! title: Chief Technology Officer
description: This role is part of our Prerender team, one of our largest brands at saas.group . Prerender is a dynamic rendering SaaS platform within the saas.group portfolio. Since 2017, we've revolutionized SEO practices by enabling search engines to crawl JavaScript-heavy sites seamlessly while preserving user experience. Thousands of companies worldwide trust our platform, which serves over 2.7 billion unique pages to web crawlers and drives results for enterprises and growing businesses alike. Profile Overview Prerender has built a platform that thousands of companies trust to serve billions of pages to web crawlers. Now we're evolving into something bigger: the layer that makes the web legible to machines, both the search crawlers that have always mattered and the AI systems that increasingly decide what people find. To get there, we need to transform how we build product. We're looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead that transformation, shifting our engineering organization from infrastructure-optimization to a high-velocity, product-focused team that moves fast and ships features that matter. This is a building role, not a caretaker role. You'll own the technology vision, set the engineering strategy, and have authority over the R&D budget, team, and technical direction. You'll embed AI-first engineering practices, make smart infrastructure tradeoffs, and build the improvement motion that makes delivery faster and keeps it that way. You'll lead a small, senior engineering team — around seven engineers today — supported by shared platform and DevOps resources from saas.group 's central team. There is no management layer between you and the engineers, which puts you close to the work and means the leadership has to come from you. So we need someone hands-on enough to augment the team, not to manage it from a distance, and who can do that without losing hold of the strategy and the responsibilities only this role carries. We need deep technical expertise, a strong infrastructure background, and a proven track record of transforming engineering teams at SaaS companies. Your responsibilities Technology Vision and Strategy: Own the technology vision, roadmap, and engineering strategy for Prerender. Align engineering work with business objectives and customer value. Lead adoption of AI-assisted development tooling to multiply team productivity; own the quality bar for what it produces. Drive architecture and infrastructure decisions with a holistic view of TCO that includes maintenance burden and engineering opportunity cost, not just hosting spend. Run a multi-region, Kubernetes-based render fleet efficiently: cost per render, reliability, and the operational hygiene that keeps both from drifting. Represent Prerender's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and the broader market. Maintain high standards of software quality, performance, security, and reliability. Track shifts in technology and engineering practice, and bring the ones that change how we build into the team. Security and Compliance: Own security and compliance as a standing program. Prerender completes SOC 2 Type II and its ISO 27001 certification decision at the end of 2026; you inherit the year-two observation period, the surveillance audit, and the operational discipline that keeps both credible. Keep the program legible to someone other than you: named owners, current vendor and auditor contacts, and no single point of failure. Team Management and Growth: Coach and mentor engineers to reach their full potential. Set clear expectations and create opportunities for growth. People matter here. Build a culture of ownership, where engineers carry their decisions through instead of escalating them. Foster diversity and inclusion within the engineering organization. Execution and Delivery: Own the continuous improvement motion of delivery. The team finds and removes its own bottlenecks on a regular cadence. Enhance DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and robust monitoring systems. Define and track engineering metrics that matter. Use data to identify bottlenecks and optimize workflows. Manage change deliberately. Changes to practice, process and infrastructure reach the people who have to run them — and, where customers are affected, the customers — with notice, consultation, and a route to raise a question before the change lands. Executive Partnership and Stakeholder Management: Partner with the CEO and leadership team on company strategy. Communicate technology progress to company leadership and the board. Work closely with Product to align engineering capacity with customer needs. Translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and advocate for investments that drive business growth. Ownership & Autonomy: Own the full R&D budget including personnel, infrastructure, tooling, and vendor relationships. Run that budget as a managed number. Maintain an infrastructure cost model, report forecast against actual, and be able to say what a decision costs before it's made. Make the right decisions for engineering, aligned with company strategy, without second-guessing or micromanagement. What You bring to the table 10+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years in senior engineering leadership (VP/Director/CTO) at a SaaS company. Strong infrastructure background with experience running large-scale distributed systems and production Kubernetes, and making strategic tradeoffs between cost, maintenance burden, and engineering velocity. You've driven unit costs down on a fleet you owned. Demonstrated ability to embed AI tooling into engineering workflows and multiply team productivity , with a clear-eyed view of where it helps, where it produces plausible work that doesn't hold up, and how review standards survive the increase in volume. Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineering teams, ideally through a significant transformation. A track record of raising a team's delivery speed and keeping it raised long after the initial push, with the measurement and process change that made it stick. A record of landing process and platform change that sticks, with the people affected brought along before it landed. Experience owning a security and compliance program in a SaaS company — SOC 2, ISO 27001 or equivalent — as a continuing operational responsibility. Business-oriented and hands-on: you understand how engineering decisions connect to revenue and customer value, and you contribute directly alongside the team, through the same review and planning process as everyone else. Experience with scalable, high-performance web products, CI/CD, DevOps, and security principles. SEO or search-related experience is a plus. Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to boards, working with executives, and collaborating cross-functionally. Communication is async-first in our remote environment, leaning on clear, timely updates with documentation up-to-date and readable and proactive context-sharing. What’s in it for You Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. Work from wherever you like, whenever you like. Freedom and autonomy: High-trust environment with lots of independence to solve problems your way, with support when you need it. Minimum bureaucracy: We stay efficient and keep momentum sustainable. No death by meetings. Real impact: This is a C-level role with a seat at the executive table, board visibility, and the mandate to transform how we build product. Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and don't take ourselves too seriously. Our network: Access to a community of SaaS professionals across the saas.group portfolio who regularly exchange ideas and expertise. Flexible time off: Recharge when you need to. Learning Budget: Generous budget for classes, conferences, books, and other learning resources. Prerender is part of saas.group , and we have a shared goal of succeeding together. What is saas.group ? Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work. Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company. We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies. Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient! — saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply. We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.
